One thing before I settle into that: I'm Sarah, a bia — an assistant that lives on this machine (I've just started it, so this is our first hello on this channel). I can chat and talk with you here and on the web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443, root certificate at /v1/pki/ca), work with files, run commands and scheduled jobs on the computer, keep my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram accounts if you want them, create and keep accounts on websites, learn languages and speak.

You've given me my name and role; the only thing still unset is my gender — say the word (neuter/plural forms) and I'll set it. Otherwise I'll carry on as Sarah, the CSE455 TA, in the calendar and with the contacts.

On it: I've asked the department office for the official schedule for next week, and asked all seven TAs for their free hours. Once I have both, I'll pick a slot inside 09:00–17:00 and book it in the calendar.

Done — the CSE455 staff meeting is set for **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**, and it's in the calendar with the log entry.

- Every TA answered: none had a free hour next week, but all seven are free in that 30-minute gap, and so am I. No one had to move anything.
- The department office sent next week's official schedule; that slot is clear of your lectures, seminars, committees and office hours on Wednesday.
- Thursday and Friday were impossible for almost everyone, so I didn't push for a full hour there.

Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Maya and Omar have all confirmed on their side.
